title: Late Fee, Credit Limit and Credit Hold Figures — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
Credit control figures for every tier of **Service Accounts and Repair Orders**:

| Tier | Late fee grace (calendar days after the due date) | Late fee per calendar month (share of the past-due balance) | Smallest late fee (USD) | Days past due at which the account goes on credit hold | Credit limit (USD) | Reinstatement only once the whole past-due balance is paid |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Service Guest Account | 0 | 0% | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 | Yes |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Silver | 0 | 0% | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 | Yes |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Gold | 0 | 0% | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 | Yes |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Platinum | 0 | 0% | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 | Yes |
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 | 5 | 1.5% | 25.00 | 45 | 10000.00 | Yes |
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30 | 5 | 1.5% | 25.00 | 60 | 25000.00 | Yes |

The retail tiers carry no credit limit and pay at pickup, so their late fee and credit hold figures are 0.

**Hypothetical.** On a Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 account a past-due balance of 1240.00 gives 1.5% of it, 18.60, which is below the 25.00 smallest fee, so the late fee is 25.00; a past-due balance of 2900.00 gives 43.50.
